extractionNotes: IN PROGRESS - Strand 1 only committed so far; Strands 2-4 to follow in this same file per incremental-write instruction.

Filename has a doubled '-Curriculum-Curriculum' suffix; this is a source naming quirk only, subject is unambiguously 'Economics' (cover page title 'ECONOMICS CURRICULUM FOR SECONDARY EDUCATION (SHS 1 - 3)').

True document length is 124 PDF pages, not 123: pdftotext's raw form-feed count (used in the prior inventory pass) undercounts by one because the final page has no trailing form-feed character. Confirmed by direct extraction of PDF page 124 (printed footer '122 | ECONOMICS'), which contains real, previously-unseen curriculum content (Content Standard 3.4.3.CS.2). Page offset confirmed consistent throughout the body: pdfPageIndex = printedPage + 2.

MAJOR STRUCTURAL FINDING: the document's own 'SCOPE AND SEQUENCE' summary table (printed page 21) groups Sub-Strands under Strands differently than the body content actually does, and the table's own numeric columns are badly run together in text extraction (e.g. '1 24', '12 13 28 13') as previously flagged. Per-body verification (reading every Strand/Sub-Strand heading in the actual Learning Outcome / Content Standard tables) shows the TRUE structure is: Strand 1 CONSUMERS' RATIONAL DECISION MAKING (3 sub-strands: Introduction to the Subject Economics, Demand for Goods and Services, Consumer Behaviour); Strand 2 FIRMS' INNOVATIVE DECISION MAKING (3 sub-strands: Production of Goods and Services, Supply of Goods and Services, Market Analysis); Strand 3 PRICE ANALYSIS AND PREDICTION IN THE MODERN ECONOMY (only 1 sub-strand in the body: Price and Equilibrium Analysis - codes 1.3.1/2.3.1/3.3.1); Strand 4, printed in the body as 'GOVERNMENT ECONOMIC POLICY AND TRADE' (not the scope-table's 'Government Economic Policy, Money, Agriculture and Trade'), has 3 sub-strands: Macroeconomic Variables (GDP, Inflation, Unemployment, Exchange Rate) - codes 1.4.1/2.4.1/3.4.1, Concept of Money, Financial Institutions and Public Finance - codes 1.4.2/2.4.2/3.4.2, and Agriculture, Industrialization and Trade - codes 1.4.3/2.4.3/3.4.3. The scope-and-sequence table implies 'Macroeconomic Variables' belongs under Strand 3 (as a second sub-strand) but its actual printed curriculum codes throughout the body place it under Strand 4 as sub-strand 1. This is preserved as extracted from the body (treated as authoritative per task instructions); the scope-and-sequence table's grouping is a document-level inconsistency, not corrected here.

CS:LO RATIO FINDING (resolves the prior inventory's flagged discrepancy): the prior inventory's Scope-and-Sequence table read 'Overall Totals (SHS 1-3): 37 Content Standards / 38 Learning Outcomes / 84 Learning Indicators', differing CS/LO by one. Direct body-content verification (counting every printed .CS. and .LO. code across all three years) instead gives Content Standards = 38 and Learning Outcomes = 38 (an exact 1:1 match, not off-by-one), and Learning Indicators = 86 (not 84). The scope-and-sequence table's totals are therefore a table-extraction/summary-table counting artifact, not a genuine CS:LO structural mismatch in this document. Per-year body-verified totals: Year 1 (SHS 1) = 13 CS / 13 LO / 28 LI; Year 2 (SHS 2) = 13 CS / 13 LO / 32 LI; Year 3 (SHS 3) = 12 CS / 12 LO / 26 LI.

Year Three (SHS 3) has NO content at all for Strand 1 Sub-Strand 1 'Introduction to the Subject Economics' - the Year Three body jumps directly from the 'YEAR THREE' divider to Sub-Strand 2 (Demand for Goods and Services, code 3.1.2). This matches the scope-and-sequence table's own '---' entry for that cell/year and is therefore treated as an intentional omission in the source rather than an extraction fault; no 3.1.1.* node exists in this file.

Curriculum codes are not globally unique: within several Sub-Strands that have two Content Standards, the Learning Indicator and Assessment sequence numbers restart at .1 under the second Content Standard (e.g. 1.2.1.CS.1 has LI.1-LI.2, then 1.2.1.CS.2 independently has its own LI.1-LI.3) - the same pattern documented for Agricultural Science. The natural key for a Learning Indicator in this subject is therefore (Year, Strand, SubStrand, ContentStandard, Seq), not the printed code string alone.

The printed body-text bullet character does not decode in the PDF's text layer (renders as the replacement glyph '�'). This is a font/tooling artifact affecting every bulleted list in the document (21st Century Skills sub-points, GESI bullet lists, SEL bullet lists, Teaching and Learning Materials lists) - not missing or garbled curriculum content. Per the same tooling-vs-content distinction applied in the Biomedical Science extraction, these bullet markers are simply omitted (represented as normal array items / sentence breaks) rather than reproducing the undecodable glyph.

A small number of GESI/SEL bullet items across the document are entirely unrecoverable icon/decoration glyphs in the text layer, rendering as strings like "'^Z/Z" / "^ZZZZ>" / lone "Z"/"ZZZZ" fragments (observed at minimum on the pages behind printed pages ~23, ~58-60, ~66-67, ~73, ~90). These appear to be inline icon or symbol elements with no real text equivalent (same phenomenon flagged in the prior inventory pass around printed page 23) rather than lost prose; they are omitted from the extracted guidance text rather than reproduced, and are called out here rather than on every individual affected node.

Several Sub-Strand header tables extract with the 'Subject' / 'Strand' / 'Sub-Strand' label column and its value column transposed by the PDF's multi-column layout (e.g. Strand 2 Sub-Strand 1, Year 1, prints as 'ECONOMICS' / 'Subject 2. FIRMS' INNOVATIVE DECISION MAKING' / '1. PRODUCTION OF GOODS AND SERVICES' / 'Strand' / 'Sub-Strand' in raw reading order). This is a layout-column-collision extraction artifact only; the intended Subject/Strand/Sub-Strand values are unambiguous and are recorded normally (correctly assigned) in this file, not reproduced in their scrambled raw order.

Webb's DoK level labels under 'Assessment' are printed with a trailing colon in some Sub-Strand blocks (e.g. 'Level 1 Recall:') and without one in others (e.g. 'Level 1 Recall') within the same document, confirming the prior inventory's note. Preserved exactly as printed per Learning Indicator; not normalised and not flagged individually on every occurrence.

Various curriculum codes are printed with minor typographical inconsistencies (missing periods, e.g. '1.1.2.CS1', '1.1.3AS.1', '1.4.3.LO1', '2.2.2.CS1', '2.2.2LI.1', '3.1.3.LO1', '3.1.3.CS1'; a stray space, e.g. '2.2.1.LI 2'; a stray space before a period in a heading, 'Sub-Strand 3 .AGRICULTURE, INDUSTRIALIZATION, AND TRADE'). These are preserved verbatim in the 'code' fields exactly as printed and are not individually flagged NEEDS_REVIEW since their intended meaning is unambiguous; only genuinely ambiguous or colliding codes are flagged at the specific node.
